newsitem.title: POLAND: KREDYT BANK TO CO-FOUND BANK IN UKRAINE.
newsitem.headline: KREDYT BANK TO CO-FOUND BANK IN UKRAINE.

text.p: Polish Kredyt Bank SA plans to launch a bank in Ukraine together with the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), Dutch Rabobank and the UKRAINA Bank, the bank said in a statement on Thursday.
The bank's statement gave no further details and its officials were not immediately available for comment.

The bank also said it had signed an agreement with the West Ukrainian Commercial Bank on Monday on cooperation in accounts management, securities trade, capital market operations and corporate services.
The agreement is a step in the bank's effort to expand on the former Soviet countries' markets, the statement said. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
